meta.title: Yu-Hung Chen | History Student, Photographer, Self-taught Developer
meta.description: Yu-Hung Chen, history student at Tunghai University, Taiwan. Low-light photography of stages, temples and the city at night, and interactive study websites built from his courses.

hero.name: Yu-Hung Chen
hero.sentence: History student, photographer and self-taught developer. I shoot stages, temples and the city after dark, and turn my courses into websites.

sections.photos_statement: I picked up a camera to cover student council events in high school. I still work where the light is lowest: in front of a stage, beside a temple fire, out on New Year's Eve.
sections.contact_statement: Photography commissions, study partners, or a website to build together: write to me.
